method: Resources are matched to cards by the place they show. Each is classified as measured (geometry captured from the place itself: photogrammetry, aerial photogrammetry or laser scanning) or modeled (built by hand, including reconstructions of an earlier or lost state). methodEvidence is "stated" when the creator says how it was made (description or tags) and "inferred" when the class was judged from the model itself (photo-textured mesh recording damage as found, versus clean geometry, regular forms or no texture); methodNote gives the reason. Portable objects now in museums are not linked to sites. Ambiguous matches are left out.
